# Spuro 0.1.1

Corrects the project license to GNU Affero General Public License version 3 only
(AGPL-3.0-only), as intended by the owner. All platform archives include the complete
AGPL-3.0 license text. No scanner behavior changed.

Supersedes v0.1.0 for installation. The original v0.1.0 publication included an
incorrectly selected MIT license; its historical tag and files are retained.

Requires native Git. Archives contain Spuro and both optional adapters for Linux,
macOS, and Windows on amd64/arm64. Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS.
